b79d8494fa.q: What is the difference between what a handshake settles and what a contract legally binds in business relationships?
b79d8494fa.a: A handshake can settle things that a contract cannot. The space between what is legally binding and what is actually trustworthy can make the difference in building an enterprise or simply doing business as a one-time opportunity. Understanding the difference between what is in a contract that is written and what is in a contract that is shared from a very human day-to-day perspective is crucial.

438ec7034d.q: How does trustworthiness differ from simply being listened to or reaching agreement in business?
438ec7034d.a: Simply because someone listens to you or agrees with you does not mean they have found you to be trustworthy. It can simply mean they found what you said to be true or made a valid point. What follows through on that agreement, and how people follow through, is what actually builds trust.

aaecf73f58.q: What role does confidentiality play in business contracts and relationships?
